h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Shimla

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Shimla

items.pText: Getting playground equipment to a school in Shimla is partly a road question. Many campuses and localities sit on narrow, steep lanes where a large truck cannot reach the gate. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 1,370 km away, and we plan the last stretch of delivery with you before dispatch.

Himachal's capital has cold winters with snow, a wet monsoon and mild summers, and schools here have a long history. We supply schools, hotels, localities and municipal gardens in and around the town. Tell us the size of your site, how close a vehicle can get and the age group of the children, and send a few photos. Our reply will include suggested pieces and a drawing of the site with each safe play area shown.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Snow, frost and terraced ground in Shimla

c: Flat land is scarce, so most play areas go on a terrace or a levelled corner of the campus. Grouted footings need to sit below the soft top layer and stay firm through freeze and thaw. Ask your local contractor to confirm the depth for your slope.

Snow loads and frost are hard on bare metal and untreated wood. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic handle them well. After heavy snow, clear it off decks and slides before children play, and check that footings have not shifted once the thaw starts. Rubber flooring drains faster than soil in the monsoon. items.q: Can you deliver to a site with narrow hill access?
items.a: Yes, with some planning. Tell us how close a vehicle can get to your site and send photos of the approach. We plan packing and the last stretch of delivery with you.
Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic cope with snow and frost. Clear snow off the equipment before use and check bolts and footings after the winter.

items.q: Do you supply hotels in Shimla?
items.a: Yes. We supply hotels, resorts, schools and public gardens. Share your site details and the age group of guests' children and we will suggest a layout.
